sloka: उद्धृत्य च भुजौ काचिद्भूमौ स्म परिवर्तते ।हतस्य वदनं दृष्ट्वा काचिन्मोहमुपागमत् ।। ६.११३.९ ।।
transliteration: uddhṛtya ca bhujau kācidbhūmau sma parivartate ।hatasya vadanaṁ dṛṣṭvā kācinmohamupāgamat ।। 6.113.9 ।।

translations.english: Some lifting their arms threw themselves on ground, some rolled, some beholding the dead Ravana's face became deluded.
